findingProjection.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1586 [medium] collectReviewerEvidenceState unconditionally reads prompt-envelopes.json even when reviewerFindings and reviewerPasses are both empty. This violates CHK-002:edge:0 explicit zero-record no-unnecessary-envelope-read contract and adds ledger I/O to every empty readiness check; the pre-change collector did not read the envelope ledger on that path. Guard snapshot creation on the presence of evidence while retaining the shared snapshot for non-empty collections.

packages/main/src/tasks/review-incremental-context-smoke.ts:626-647 and .proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/acceptance-rollout-report.json:1423-1427 — the mandatory Wave 4 coverage is not executable evidence for this story: the smoke only asserts one collector read plus one valid B pass, while the signed rollout inventory lists acceptance_topology_check, pre_review_check, and acceptance_rollout_check only. Prompt prose and inventory metadata cannot satisfy this boundary.

.proof-or-stop/story/actives/B-a2a6/red-evidence.json:8-19 — the only red record targets CHK-001:happy:0 but records B-dc83 as both failing and expected green command, and its note explicitly says green is only expected after the separate cache fix; it contains no observed green exit code, receipt, output digest, or current HEAD/material binding for B-a2a6.
